import sys

def f(s):
    # Replace first occurrence of "at" from index 1 onward
    # Find first "at" in substring s[1:]
    pos = s.find("at", 1)  # start search from index 1
    if pos != -1:
        s = s[:pos] + "@" + s[pos+2:]
    # Replace all "dot" from index 1 onward
    suffix = s[1:]
    suffix = suffix.replace("dot", ".")
    s = s[0] + suffix
    return s

def main():
    for token in sys.stdin.read().split():
        print(f(token))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
